guidance.statement: EBITDA profile moving from ~11% to 20%+ long term
Capacity expansion to ~800 KL mid-term and ~1,000 KL long-term from ~500 KL

operating_notes.text: Term loan facility of ₹30 Cr availed from Shinhan Bank at 7.60% interest rate with a 36-month tenure.
QIP of ₹200 Cr (Aug 2024) had ₹175.52 Cr utilised by March 31, 2026, with ₹13.56 Cr unutilised and held in debt mutual funds.
CARE Ratings attributes four quarters of subdued profitability to API segment margin compression from declining realisations and rising costs, with improvement in Q3FY26.
Recommended final dividend of Rs. 0.20 per equity share for FY26.
Q4FY26: API business grew 17% and Medical Devices 31% YoY; Medical Devices FY26 revenue ₹598 Cr, up 21%, with nearly 17 million repeat users.
Q4FY26: manufacturing capacity being expanded from ~500 KL toward ~800 KL, with a longer-term roadmap toward ~1000 KL.
Q4FY26: fourth consecutive USFDA inspection completed with NIL 483 observations; 403 DMF filings worldwide.
Secured multi-year CDMO mandate of Rs. 823 Cr with commercial production commenced and phased delivery starting in the next few weeks.
API business has ~500 MT manufacturing and delivery scale, over 70% export business and over 80% repeat customers.
Devices business FY26 revenue Rs. 597 Cr with ~20% annual growth and installed base of ~17 Mn users.

timeline.summary: Morepen Laboratories executed a loan agreement with Shinhan Bank for an unsecured term loan facility of ₹30 Cr.

CARE Ratings' monitoring report for the quarter ended March 2026 showed nil deviation on Morepen's ₹200 Cr QIP, ₹175.52 Cr utilised, ₹13.56 Cr of Baddi device capex extended to March 2027, and a ₹117.94 Cr GST refund notice stayed by the Himachal Pradesh High Court.
On May 20, 2026, Morepen Laboratories agreed to transfer 1,62,000 shares in subsidiary Morepen Medipath Limited to Mr. Anubhav Suri, reducing its stake from 60% to 51%.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹484.72 Cr (+4.1% YoY), net profit ₹15.74 Cr (-22.5% YoY).

Q4FY26 press release (May 27, 2026): net profit rose 69% YoY to ₹20 Cr on gross revenue of ₹472 Cr (+22%), EBITDA flat at ₹32 Cr, commercial production began under the ₹825 Cr CDMO mandate, and the board proposed a 10% FY26 dividend.

Morepen's Q4 & FY26 investor presentation disclosed a secured multi-year CDMO mandate of ₹823 Cr with commercial production commenced and phased delivery starting in the next few weeks, alongside a capacity plan from ~500 KL to ~1,000 KL and a long-term 20%+ EBITDA target.
Morepen Laboratories Limited’s promoter group, including Sushil Suri and 49 entities, declared no encumbrance on shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI regulations.
Morepen Laboratories reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹746.50 Cr and net profit of ₹88.89 Cr, alongside a favourable High Court order quashing a ₹117.94 Cr GST show cause notice.
